title: Statcast Showcase
headline_insight: The 2025 Statcast pull holds 693,037 pitches, and the framing ingredients (plate location, zone edges) are present on 99.63% of them.
what_it_means: That coverage is enough to compute catcher-framing-style metrics from location. Four-seam fastballs are the most common pitch at 31.78% of the pull, sinkers next at 15.46%. A separate preregistered framing check (surfaced here as context only) reports a borderline called-strike-rate metric tracking its target more tightly than a declared naive baseline, with the sign holding in 7 of 8 folds and a verdict of PREDICTIVE_VERIFIED.
how_to_read: The distribution table is the pitch-type mix, the percentile table is velocity by pitch type, and the coverage table is column completeness. The framing block is cited context, not recomputed in this showcase.
why_it_matters: It shows the raw-material depth behind the MLB metrics, a coverage statement rather than a performance claim.
caveat: Descriptive data-coverage only; this showcase does NOT recompute any predictive-validity result. The framing rho is context carried from a corpus-deviation recompute (cutoffs shifted one season to match data that exists), compared to a declared naive baseline, never versus the market close.
as_of: 2025 Statcast pull (no generation timestamp in artifact)
